scope: Real authenticated production browser GET validation of /knowledge after release-owner deployment confirmation
case_data_provenance: Two controlled imported synthetic case records seeded by the release owner; the browser did not create or revoke them
screenshots: Knowledge content only; account sidebar excluded. Public case screenshot masks source values, case headings, and source links; unmasked screenshots remain in the private parent directory.
axe_boundary: Four scans have zero violations. Desktop scans each retain one aria-prohibited-attr incomplete on the pre-existing .workspace-switch div; mobile scans have zero incomplete. This is not a claim of complete automated accessibility certification.
asset_boundary: All eight JS/CSS resources actually loaded during Guide-to-Knowledge navigation, plus index.html, were fetched via production GET and SHA-256 matched to local web/dist.
script_timing_correction: One supplemental run initially evaluated keyboard tab state before React query navigation committed. The script now waits up to 10 seconds for the same selected-tab and focused-tab condition, and the complete final run passed. The intermediate receipt remains private.
auth_boundary: One explicit login POST per run; storageState remained in memory, with no persisted cookies, tokens, trace, HAR, response bodies or account screenshots. Browser product requests were restricted to same-origin GET/HEAD.
